items.name: Consolidated order book at end of period FY2025
items.claim: Thales reported a consolidated ORDER BOOK (backlog) at end of period of EUR 53,323 million, up from EUR 50,602 million a year earlier.
items.source_excerpt: Order book at end of period 53,323 50,602 +5% +7%

items.name: Defence segment order book FY2025
items.claim: At December 31, 2025, Thales' Defence segment order book reached EUR 10.8 billion, up 6% at constant scope and exchange rates compared to 2024.
items.source_excerpt: At December 31, 2025, the segment’s order book reached €10.8 billion, up 6% at constant scope and exchange rates compared to 2024.

notes: FY2025 full-year results press release, stored 2026-09-14 (REQ-20260914-1374), discloses both consolidated and segment-level order book.
